mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT_WS(',', m1.id, m2.id, m3.id, m4.id, m5.id, m6.id) as parent_id FROM sys_business_variable m1 LEFT JOIN sys_business_variable m2 on m2.parent_id = m1.id LEFT JOIN sys_business_variable m3 on m3.parent_id = m2.id LEFT JOIN sys_business_variable m4 on m4.parent_id = m3.id LEFT JOIN sys_business_variable m5 on m5.parent_id = m4.id LEFT JOIN sys_business_variable m6 on m6.parent_id = m5.id WHERE m1.code = #{code} and m1.parent_id is null and m1.be_used = 1

SELECT CONCAT_WS(',',m1.id,m2.id,m3.id,m4.id,m5.id,m6.id) as parent_id FROM sys_business_variable m1 LEFT JOIN sys_business_variable m2 on m2.parent_id = m1.id LEFT JOIN sys_business_variable m3 on m3.parent_id = m2.id LEFT JOIN sys_business_variable m4 on m4.parent_id = m3.id LEFT JOIN sys_business_variable m5 on m5.parent_id = m4.id LEFT JOIN sys_business_variable m6 on m6.parent_id = m5.id WHERE m1.id in
#{item}

SELECT id,code,name FROM sys_business_variable v WHERE v.be_used = 1 and v.parent_id is null
AND (code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{codeOrName},'%') OR name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{codeOrName},'%')) ORDER BY length(REPLACE(code,#{codeOrName},''))/length(code), length(REPLACE(name,#{codeOrName},''))/length(name)
LIMIT 10
